problems: ORCHESTRATOR DECISION (review finding 5, not applied): the Low Countries are drawn by both iberian-union (1580-1640) and habsburg-netherlands (1482-1795, eu-09); dutch-republic names habsburg-netherlands as counterpart of every Dutch-front event. This repair pass added three more Dutch-front gains (1585, 1606, 1637) that would be dropped together with the other counterpart=dutch-republic events if habsburg-netherlands keeps the Low Countries; the notes list the keyframes to drop or trim (iberian-union_1585, 1606, 1625, 1627 and the Belgian part of the others).

Fixes applied in full: finding 3 (1585 gains, keyframe iberian-union_1585, 1588 gain north-east only), finding 4 (1606 gain, keyframes from 1606, 1625-1628 split), Venlo and Roermond 1637, Cork and Bahrain removed from the shape from 1602 with a 1602 Bahrain loss to safavid-dynasty. Notes-only (pages silent): Palatinate 1632/1636, Elba cells, Zutphen/Deventer lower bound (after 1586), Dutch contest start kept at 1582.

DISAGREEMENT with the reviewer: the reviewer says Cliopatria's 1609 shape re-adds Twente and Achterhoek cells; the gazetteer shows 0 cells within 12 km of Oldenzaal or Groenlo in every union shape 1600-1636, so the 1606 keyframes add the two forts by correction. The reviewer's dates 'Zutphen 1583, Deventer 1587' and 'Porto Longone 1603' are on none of the pages opened. Dutch contest start not moved to 1580: dutch-republic starts in 1582.

The Spinola page and the Cardinal-Infante Ferdinand page attach their years only through neighbouring sentences or paragraphs; WebFetch returns a small-model summary, so quotes are as returned. The URL Siege_of_Antwerp_(1584-1585) did not exist; Fall_of_Antwerp was used instead.

Cross-dossier mismatches for other batches: yarubid-dynasty /ledger/1 (1633, Julfar from iberian-union) has no matching loss and the union's 1600 shape does not cover Julfar (me-10); electoral-palatinate /ledger/7 dates the occupation to 1621 with counterpart kingdom-of-spain, iberian-union has August 1620 (eu-09 or the owner of that dossier); safavid-dynasty's 1602 Bahrain gain names portuguese-empire while iberian-union's loss names safavid-dynasty; kingdom-of-france/kingdom-of-spain disagree with catalonia on 1641-1652 and kingdom-of-spain /ledger/51 should be split at 11 September 1714 and June 1715 (review catalonia and pro-habsburg-spain, both pass, untouched).
Page budget: the iberian-union budget was 5 pages; the repair pass opened 13 more pages (all in sources[]); the reviewer's thin list asked for them.
